Documentation Get started

Native first, production ready

Build polished interfaces from HTML

Start with semantic elements, add one stylesheet, and opt into small accessible behaviors only where the platform needs help. Use the controls in the sidebar to test every example across both themes and all color schemes.

Install SDS Lite Browse component guides
This page is the example Inspect its source for a complete application shell, then use the copy-ready recipes below for individual components.

Five-minute setup

Choose NPM or CDN

Both paths produce the same framework-neutral HTML. Use NPM with a build tool or CDN for a standalone page.

Follow the complete quick start
Recommended

NPM

Authenticate with GitHub Packages once, then install and import CSS and automatic behavior. 

npm install @cmu-sei/sds-lite

import '@cmu-sei/sds-lite/sds.css'
import '@cmu-sei/sds-lite/auto'
NPM guide
No build step

CDN

Use version-pinned CDN links in a standalone page when you do not need a build tool. 

<link rel="stylesheet"
  href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/cmu-sei/sds-lite@v0.1.0/dist/sds.css">
<script type="module"
  src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/cmu-sei/sds-lite@v0.1.0/dist/auto.js"></script>
CDN guide
Then write HTML Add data-sds-root to a container. Native headings, links, buttons, and form controls work immediately.

Forms

Native controls and states

Labels and native attributes provide semantics, validation, autofill, and keyboard behavior.

API reference and copy-ready markup
.sds-field .sds-switch .sds-file-input .sds-file-upload data-sds-size="sm | lg" data-sds-orientation="horizontal" disabled readonly aria-invalid="true" :user-valid
Copy a field 
<div class="sds-field">
  <label for="project-name">Project name</label>
  <input id="project-name" name="project-name" required>
  <small>Use a short, recognizable name.</small>
</div>

Text and contact fields

Helpful text belongs directly below the field.

Composition

Layout primitives and application structure

Semantic HTML creates polished application layouts without component JavaScript or generated markup.

API reference and copy-ready markup
.sds-sidebar-layout + .sds-sidebar .sds-grid[data-sds-columns] .sds-grid[data-sds-min-column-width] .sds-grid[data-sds-orientation="vertical"] .sds-grid[data-sds-place-items] data-sds-place-self .sds-flex[data-sds-stack-at] data-sds-padding* data-sds-margin* .sds-list[data-sds-divided] .sds-list-marker timeline data-sds-orientation="horizontal" aria-current="step"
Copy a sidebar layout 
<div class="sds-sidebar-layout">
  <aside class="sds-sidebar">
    <header><strong>Project Atlas</strong></header>
    <nav aria-label="Project">
      <ul><li><a href="/" aria-current="page">Overview</a></li></ul>
    </nav>
  </aside>
  <main>Project content</main>
</div>
Copy spacing utilities 
<section
  data-sds-padding="lg"
  data-sds-margin-block-end="xl"
>
  Section content
</section>

Prose

Long-form content

Dependency-free typography for articles, documentation, and generated rich text.

API reference and copy-ready markup
.sds-prose data-sds-size="sm | md | lg" data-sds-tone="neutral | accent | info | success | warning | danger" .sds-not-prose
Copy a prose container 
<article class="sds-prose" data-sds-tone="info">
  <h1>Article title</h1>
  <p class="sds-prose-lead">A short introduction.</p>
  <p>Semantic HTML receives the complete typography treatment.</p>
</article>

Building resilient software

Good systems make the correct path obvious while retaining the flexibility experts need.

Prose supports strong text, emphasis, inline links, inline code, and keyboard input such as Command + K.

Clear information hierarchy

Headings, paragraphs, lists, quotations, code, media, and tables share predictable vertical rhythm.

Ordered work

  1. Define the outcome.
  2. Implement the smallest complete path.
    1. Preserve native semantics.
    2. Verify observable behavior.
  3. Document the interface.

Supporting principles

  • Keep interfaces small.
  • Keep related implementation local.
  • Prefer browser standards.
A design system should reduce the knowledge required to produce a consistent interface.

Terms

Module
A focused capability behind a clear interface.
Token
A named design decision shared by multiple recipes.

Navigation

Tabs and pagination

Tabs add keyboard behavior; pagination remains ordinary link navigation.

API reference and copy-ready markup
data-sds-variant="folder | block | underline" data-sds-size="md | lg" sds-tabs tone="neutral | accent | info | success | warning | danger" sds-tabs activation="automatic | manual" sds-tabs orientation="horizontal | vertical" aria-selected="true" chooses the initial tab disabled
Copy SSR-ready tabs 
<sds-tabs variant="underline">
  <div class="sds-tab-list" role="tablist" aria-label="Project sections">
    <button id="tab-1" class="sds-tab" role="tab"
      aria-controls="panel-1" aria-selected="true" tabindex="0">Overview</button>
  </div>
  <section id="panel-1" class="sds-tab-panel" role="tabpanel"
    aria-labelledby="tab-1">Overview content</section>
</sds-tabs>

Structure and behavior

Dropdowns, floating content, disclosures, and overlays

Browser primitives provide the semantics; SDS adds a small declarative enhancement layer.

API reference and copy-ready markup
sds-dropdown width="sm | md | lg | xl | 2xl | auto" floating placement="block-start | block-end | inline-start | inline-end" with optional -start | -end floating offset="nonnegative pixels" sds-popover width="sm | md | lg | xl | 2xl | auto" dialog data-sds-width="sm | md | lg | xl | 2xl" panel data-sds-side="left | right | bottom" panel data-sds-width="sm | md | lg | xl"
Copy a dropdown 
<sds-dropdown width="sm">
                  <button type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-controls="menu"
    aria-expanded="false" popovertarget="menu">Actions</button>
                  <menu id="menu" class="sds-dropdown-menu" popover="auto"
                    role="menu" aria-orientation="vertical">
                    <li role="none"><button type="button" role="menuitem"
                      tabindex="-1">Edit</button></li>
  </menu>
</sds-dropdown>

    Tooltips and popovers

    Tooltips open immediately on hover or focus. Popovers open after a 500ms hover or focus delay, remain open while their content is in use, and also support click and touch activation.
